design.representation: Versioned bounded native data segments plus a physically bounded paged catalog/index under data/qledger; one logical claims stream. A single ever-growing catalog JSONL is prohibited.
design.legacy_preservation: Freeze the exact accepted published claims.jsonl byte-for-byte as an integrity anchor/base source; do not truncate, exclude or re-register history.
design.unpublished_tail_gate: Original CI/publication owner must classify both failed-run tails/commits before any continuity acceptance. Preserve known rows and original clocks; no assumption that published main contains runner-only effects.
design.catalog: Logical append-only ordered storage descriptors in immutable bounded leaf pages, reached through bounded-fanout copy-on-write index pages and a fixed-shape root containing format/base identity and one index-root reference. Descriptors hold storage transaction IDs, hashes, byte/row counts, order and revisions, not new claim/grade authority. Root/index files are not blindly line-union merged.
design.segment: Bounded complete-line immutable parts under data/qledger/claims.parts/. Existing row bytes/unknown fields are retained. Proposed conservative part ceiling64MiB; final threshold and staged/reachable object limits require native publication-owner acceptance.
design.raw_order: Legacy base followed by append descriptors in accepted published order; exact repeated storage descriptors are idempotent, while business-row duplicates are preserved. No sorting/dedup by claim_id/asof/timestamp.
design.registration: Keep register/register_batch APIs, validation, return order, first-existing lookup, dedupe=False behavior, statuses and clock hooks. Extend read-dedupe-append over the logical stream.
design.rewrite_exception: backfill_regime_stamps gets a storage-native compare-and-replace transaction targeting exact segment digests and row positions. Old bytes remain retained; replacement parts occupy identical logical positions. Only existing permitted null-fill/provenance changes may differ. Concurrent rewrite vs append/conflicting revisions fail or reconcile through incumbent owner; never generic last-writer JSON overwrite.
design.reader_modes: Shared raw-line source seam supplies coherent ordered logical lines and receipt. Each consumer retains existing parser/count/order policy; storage-integrity failures in v2 never become empty history.
design.old_runners: Reader-compatible release first. Actual old writers must be drained/reconciled/fenced at cutover. Old executables cannot be made safe merely by adding a manifest; no current drain is asserted.
design.concurrency: Preserve existing separate-clone Git publication. Reconcile logical descriptor union against exact remote tree, preserve the exact accepted descriptor prefix and pending local order, then rebuild affected bounded index paths. Validate immutable data and metadata members. Never blindly line-union root/index files; reject incompatible revisions. No timestamp sorting or whole-file theirs authority.
design.interruption: Publish complete parts before a committed descriptor; no partial batch success. Unreferenced files, missing/changed parts, incomplete final descriptor and stale base hash are explicit incomplete/corrupt states; preserve, do not delete or treat as no claims. Existing owner reconciles transaction outcome.
design.size_check: Existing publishers examine staged/candidate and newly reachable blob sizes for every physical member: legacy base, data parts, catalog pages, index nodes and root. Removing an oversize file later does not erase rejected unpublished ancestry. Recovery preserves actual suffix bytes/clocks through incumbent owner without force push, truncation or unbounded metadata fallback.
design.local_concurrency: Either enforce/prove incumbent per-workspace single writer or use a native local filesystem lock around read-dedupe-append; no new distributed lease/control service.

catalog_bounds.limits: Explicit byte, entry-count and descriptor-size limits for all metadata nodes; provisional metadata page ceiling 1 MiB and maximum index fanout 128 require native owner acceptance. Explicit supported depth/capacity limit fails before mutation when exhausted.
catalog_bounds.rollover: Full leaf rolls to a new leaf; full index rolls/splits through copy-on-write ancestors. Rebuild only affected index paths; fixed-shape root never lists every page or part. Logical descriptor order remains append-only. Revision records use the same bounded representation.
catalog_bounds.snapshot: All new data parts and metadata nodes precede root activation in the same accepted Git tree. Readers pin the root and resolve all descendants from one immutable tree or coherent local transaction snapshot. No mixed-root/worktree/HEAD generation.
catalog_bounds.integrity: Missing/corrupt nodes, cycles, invalid depth, incomplete generation and capacity exhaustion fail completeness; no oversized emergency node or unbounded fallback catalog.
catalog_bounds.publication: Existing publisher guards inspect every physical member including base, data parts, metadata pages, index nodes and root, plus newly reachable blobs. Final limits, rollover/recovery and concurrent-root reconciliation require source and synthetic proof before activation.

design.registration_guarantee: This proposal does not establish or retroactively claim global exactly-once or linearizable registration across independent clones. It preserves current observed ordering and duplicate semantics. Idempotence of an exact storage transaction replay is narrower than business-level uniqueness.
